items.title: Zendesk：生成式 AI 让代码不再稀缺，研发瓶颈转向“吸收能力”
items.raw_excerpt: Zendesk 最近提出， 生成式 AI 改变了软件交付的核心制约因素 ——从编写代码转变为所谓的“吸收能力”。所谓吸收能力是指组织清晰界定问题、将各类变更融入整体系统、验证功能行为正确性并将落地成果转化为稳定可靠价值的综合能力。在 Zendesk 的论述框架下，当代码供给变得充足，核心挑战便不再是快速产出代码，而是要避免快速生成的内容与架构一致性、评审能力及交付流程脱节。

title_i18n.zh: Zendesk：生成式 AI 让代码不再稀缺，研发瓶颈转向“吸收能力”
title_i18n.en: Zendesk: Generative AI makes code no longer scarce, shifting the R&D bottleneck to "absorption capacity."
title_i18n.es: Zendesk: La IA generativa elimina la escasez de código, trasladando el cuello de botella del desarrollo a la "capacidad de absorción".

excerpt_i18n.zh: Zendesk 最近提出， 生成式 AI 改变了软件交付的核心制约因素 ——从编写代码转变为所谓的“吸收能力”。所谓吸收能力是指组织清晰界定问题、将各类变更融入整体系统、验证功能行为正确性并将落地成果转化为稳定可靠价值的综合能力。在 Zendesk 的论述框架下，当代码供给变得充足，核心挑战便不再是快速产出代码，而是要避免快速生成的内容与架构一致性、评审能力及交付流程脱节。
excerpt_i18n.en: Zendesk recently proposed that generative AI has shifted the core constraint in software delivery—from writing code to what is termed "absorption capacity." This refers to an organization's comprehensive ability to clearly define problems, integrate various changes into the overall system, verify the correctness of functional behavior, and translate implemented outcomes into stable, reliable value. Under Zendesk's framework, as code supply becomes abundant, the key challenge is no longer producing code quickly, but rather preventing rapidly generated content from becoming disconnected from architectural consistency, review capabilities, and delivery processes.
excerpt_i18n.es: Zendesk ha planteado recientemente que la IA generativa ha transformado la restricción central en la entrega de software: de escribir código a lo que se denomina "capacidad de absorción". Esta capacidad se refiere a la habilidad integral de una organización para definir claramente los problemas, integrar diversos cambios en el sistema general, verificar la corrección del comportamiento funcional y convertir los resultados implementados en valor estable y confiable. Según el marco de Zendesk, cuando el suministro de código se vuelve abundante, el desafío principal ya no es producir código rápidamente, sino evitar que el contenido generado rápidamente se desvincule de la coherencia arquitectónica, la capacidad de revisión y los procesos de entrega.

Recently, Jindie Shikong and the Institute of Software, Chinese Academy of Sciences jointly achieved a significant technological breakthrough—the RISC-V AI CPU chip K3 successfully runs the OpenHarmony 6.1 system, making it the world's first RISC-V architecture chip to support OpenHarmony 6.1. This marks the adaptation of RISC-V chips and the open-source HarmonyOS entering a new phase of full autonomy and dual open-source in both "chip + system."  

During this adaptation process, both parties leveraged their respective technical strengths and collaborated deeply:  
▲ The Institute of Software provided OpenHarmony system-level technical support, completing RISC-V architecture compatibility and core component porting.  
▲ Jindie Shikong handled the underlying hardware adaptation, driver development, and performance optimization for the K3 chip.  

This combination truly achieves full-stack autonomy from chip to system, providing a more secure and controllable solution for smart terminals, IoT, and other fields.  

OpenHarmony 6.1 is the Long-Term Support (LTS) version released by the OpenHarmony community. Compared to previous versions, its advantages include:  
▲ Up to 3 years of official maintenance support, ensuring long-term stable iteration and making it more suitable for deployment in enterprise production environments.  
▲ Significantly enhanced application development capabilities, supporting more refined application control and smoother dynamic effects.  
▲ Upgraded system-level functionality and multimedia experience, improving system perception.
excerpt_i18n.es: Recientemente, Jindie Shikong y el Instituto de Software de la Academia China de Ciencias han logrado un importante avance tecnológico: el chip RISC-V AI CPU K3 ha ejecutado con éxito el sistema OpenHarmony 6.1, convirtiéndose en el primer chip de arquitectura RISC-V del mundo compatible con la versión 6.1 de OpenHarmony. Esto marca que la adaptación entre los chips RISC-V y el sistema operativo de código abierto Harmony ha entrado oficialmente en una nueva etapa de "chip + sistema", completamente autónoma y de doble código abierto. Durante este proceso de adaptación, ambas partes aprovecharon sus respectivas ventajas técnicas y colaboraron en profundidad: el Instituto de Software proporcionó OpenHarmony.

A "No Pretense, No Formality" Private Gathering  
On the afternoon of April 11, 15 people gathered behind closed doors at the Z·Pilot space in Nantou Ancient City, Shenzhen, for a four-hour conversation. There was no live streaming, no recording, no PowerPoint presentations, and no company introductions. The first words upon entering were "Who am I," followed immediately by speaking the truth.  

This was the first Conclave organized by HardTech Community—a closed-door meeting specifically designed for entrepreneurs in the sports technology sector. Attendees included creators of smart tennis robots, action cameras, skiing equipment, rehabilitation medical devices, and several investors.  

Not a single word typically spoken at public product launches was uttered here.  

Who is HardTech Community?  
HardTech Community is an investor community under Leiphone, focusing on hard tech sectors such as AI hardware, robotics, and smart mobility. We don’t host large conferences or pitch events—we do one thing only: gather those who are truly immersed in these fields in a room for an afternoon of candid conversation.  

HardTech Conclave is a closed-door meeting series co-organized by Leiphone’s HardTech Community and investment institutions. Each session is strictly limited to 15 participants, inviting only those with genuine entrepreneurial experience or deep industry insights. No company introductions, no business card exchanges—just discussions on insights and challenges.  

The co-organizer of this session, Different Capital, originates from the family office of one of Alibaba’s founders and focuses on cross-border e-commerce, AI software and hardware, and robotics. They have invested in companies like Walker Extraordinary, Inhands Dynamics, DeepGaze Technology, and Squirrel Dynamics, and possess a systematic framework for evaluating the sports hardware sector.  

Three questions were discussed over four hours.

On April 16, Tencent officially released and open-sourced the Hunyuan 3D World Model 2.0 (HY-World 2.0). HY-World 2.0 is a multimodal world model capable of understanding various inputs such as text, images, and videos, automatically generating, reconstructing, and simulating 3D worlds. It supports exporting multi-format 3D assets (Mesh/3DGS/point clouds, etc.) and seamlessly integrates with existing game workflows for rapidly generating game maps and level prototypes. The Hunyuan World Model 2.0 advances AI from "dialogue," "drawing," and "modeling objects" to "creating worlds"—complete worlds encompassing people, objects, and scenes. Unlike Google's Genie 3 and the Hunyuan World Model 1.5, which only generate video files, World Model 2.0 offers greater practicality: it can directly generate editable 3D asset files that can be imported into game development or embodied simulation engines, making them truly playable and usable. Currently, World Model 2.0 is available on the Tencent Hunyuan 3D Creation Engine official website, where users can apply for access. (Application link: https://3d.hunyuan.tencent.com/sceneTo3D)

HY-World 2.0 es un modelo de mundo multimodal capaz de comprender diferentes tipos de entradas como texto, imágenes y vídeo, generando, reconstruyendo y simulando automáticamente mundos 3D. Además, soporta la exportación de activos 3D en múltiples formatos (Mesh/3DGS/nube de puntos, etc.), permitiendo una integración fluida con flujos de trabajo de juegos existentes para generar rápidamente mapas y prototipos de niveles. El modelo de mundo Hunyuan 2.0 lleva la IA desde "dialogar", "dibujar" y "modelar objetos" hasta "crear mundos", incluyendo personas y objetos.

excerpt_i18n.en: On April 16, Alibaba launched HappyOyster, a world model product capable of real-time construction and interaction. Built on a native multimodal architecture, the model supports multimodal understanding and joint audio-video generation. Currently, the product offers two core capabilities: Wander and Direct, enabling users to build interactive, performable, and explorable AI digital worlds in real time. Additionally, user-generated digital worlds can be fully saved and opened for other users to remix. The product was developed by Alibaba's ATH Innovation Business Unit, the same team behind the previously popular HappyHorse. Compared to the relatively mature architecture and technical paradigms of large language models, world models remain an area of cutting-edge exploration. Alibaba's HappyOyster and Google's Genie3 both belong to the world simulator category. Unlike traditional text-to-video models, which follow a passive process of inputting prompts, waiting for rendering, and receiving the final output, this category employs long-term world evolution modeling. By learning from vast amounts of long video data and diverse control signals such as text, action commands, and image references, the model actively understands spatial, physical, and causal laws to predict plot and visual evolution. This shifts from "passive content generation" to "active simulation of world evolution," providing a key technical pathway for building interactive general-purpose world simulators. Compared to Google's approach, Alibaba's HappyOyster adopts world evolution modeling over longer time spans.

Este modelo se basa en una arquitectura multimodal nativa y admite comprensión multimodal y generación conjunta de audio y video. Actualmente, el producto ofrece dos capacidades principales: Wander (deambular) y Direct (dirigir), permitiendo a los usuarios construir mundos digitales de IA interactivos, interpretables y explorables en tiempo real. Además, los mundos digitales creados por los usuarios no solo pueden guardarse por completo, sino que también pueden compartirse para que otros usuarios los modifiquen. Se informa que el producto fue desarrollado por el equipo de Innovación ATH de Alibaba y pertenece a la misma serie que el popular HappyHorse.
